name: MM-IMDb: Multimodal Movie Genre Classification Benchmark
description: MM-IMDb (Multimodal IMDb) is a multimodal benchmark for multi-label genre classification of movies. Comprising 25,959 movie entries, each equipped with its cover poster image and textual storyline plot summary, spanning 23 movie genres to evaluate multimodal fusion architectures.
